{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))
print("QA order IDs:", qa_orders['order_id'].tolist())"}
